mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates aggressive monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains above 2.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm employment signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, retail sales growth above the 12-month moving average indicates robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, RSAFS above 12-month moving average fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm employment over six consecutive months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that elevate household income and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases for six consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO remains below 100 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate indicates monetary tightening amid strong labor demand, which typically triggers market correction as corporate costs rise without earnings slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery, industrial production growth above its 6-month moving average indicates manufacturing rebound that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-recession recovery, INDPRO above 6-month moving average fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
